description: This file contains PHP code that defines and populates reports and folders for a CRM system, including database insert functions, report definitions, filters, and sorting configurations. It primarily automates the creation and registration of various report types within the system.

methods.name: PopulateReportFolder
methods.description: Inserts a new report folder with its name and description into the database.

methods.name: insertSelectQuery
methods.description: Creates a new select query record in the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: insertSelectColumns
methods.description: Inserts selected columns for a report query into the database.

methods.name: insertReports
methods.description: Stores report metadata including name, description, and type into the database.

methods.name: insertReportModules
methods.description: Associates primary and secondary modules with a report in the database.

methods.name: insertSortColumns
methods.description: Stores sort order information for report columns.

methods.name: insertStdFilter
methods.description: Inserts standard filter criteria for reports based on date or other filters.

methods.name: insertAdvFilter
methods.description: Inserts advanced filter conditions for reports based on user-defined criteria.
